description: Wondershare EdrawMax is open and showing its Home screen. The left sidebar shows tool icons (Symbols, Text, Images, etc.) and the canvas center shows a 'Create New' card with a + icon. Click the 'Create New' card in the center of the canvas, then select 'Mind Map' from the diagram type categories that appear. If a blue notification banner ('Click here to view more temporarily saved files') is visible at the top, click its 'Got it' button to dismiss it before proceeding. Create a mind map based on the structure of the Linux kernel (a real open-source project). Central node: 'Linux Kernel'. Four main branches: (1) 'Core Subsystems' with sub-topics 'Process Scheduler', 'Memory Manager', 'Virtual File System', 'Network Stack'; (2) 'Device Drivers' with sub-topics 'Block Devices', 'Character Devices', 'Network Drivers', 'USB Drivers'; (3) 'Architecture Support' with sub-topics 'x86', 'ARM', 'RISC-V', 'PowerPC'; (4) 'Development' with sub-topics 'Linus Torvalds', 'LKML', 'Git Workflow', 'Stable Releases'. When done, save the file as 'linux_kernel_mindmap.eddx' in /home/ga/ using File > Save As.
